name: UQ students: GoGet and Flexicar special rates
summary: UQ students get special car share rates with GoGet at St Lucia, Herston and Toowong, and Flexicar at Gatton.
how: Sign up on the GoGet website (St Lucia, Herston, Toowong) or the Flexicar website (Gatton).
catches: The page does not state the rates. Flexicar's fees are listed under its Flexi Student Plan.

evidence.quote: UQ students can access special rates through the GoGet website.
UQ students can access special rates through the Flexicar website.
